title: Kaiserjägermuseum Bergisel Innsbruck
highlights: Historisches Regimentsmuseum zur Geschichte der Tiroler Kaiserjaeger von 1815 bis 1918
Historischer Standort direkt auf dem Bergisel-Huegel neben dem Tirol Panorama
Umfangreiche Sammlung an Original-Uniformen, Fahnen, Waffen und persoenlichen Feldpostbriefen
Verbindungstunnel zum Riesenrundgemaelde der Tiroler Freiheitskaempfe von 1809
kurzbeschreibung: The Kaiserjägermuseum on the Bergisel in Innsbruck documents the military history of the four Tyrolean Kaiserjäger regiments.
beschreibung:
Memorial Site on Historic Bergisel

Standing on the historic ground of the Tyrolean struggles for freedom on Bergisel is the Kaiserjägermuseum. Built in the 19th century, it is one of Austria's oldest military history museums, dedicated to the legacy of the renowned four Tyrolean Kaiserjäger regiments.

Exhibits, Memorial, and Giant Panoramic Painting

The exhibition showcases historic flags, uniforms, medals for bravery, and authentic documents from the mountain warfare in the Dolomites. An underground passageway leads directly to the Tirol Panorama with its monumental 1,000-square-meter giant cyclorama.
